template.name: Video Teaser
template.text:
Discover

Your next adventure starts here

Full-bleed background video with an overlaid teaser. Pick a video asset, or paste a streaming URL.

Explore destination

fields.name: video
fields.label: Video asset
fields.description: Pick a DAM video asset from the content tree (e.g. /content/dam/.../movie.mp4). The searchable asset selector optimizes as an image and breaks video, so this uses the content-tree picker. For streaming or external sources, use the Video URL field below instead.

fields.name: videoUrl
fields.label: Video URL (optional)
fields.description: Overrides the asset. Use for streaming: an .m3u8 manifest, a Dynamic Media OpenAPI / Scene7 URL, or a YouTube link.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Teaser Text
fields.description: Heading + description + an optional CTA link, authored as rich text.
